plus_one_description: Signed Euclidean distance from ego to nearest pothole; sentinel value 100.0 m in non-pothole scenarios for cross-scenario obs_dim invariance.
doc_added: Phase 2 audit comment added at concatenation site identifying d_pothole as the +1 component, with sentinel value, purpose, and YAML anchor.
rationale: The +1 is intentional padding so that obs_dim is invariant across pothole vs non-pothole scenarios — the observation_space shape stays (135,) regardless of which scenario the env was constructed for. This matches the PDE-state convention and was audited live in Phase 2.8 (preflight_12_obsdim) which verifies obs_dim=135 across 11 distinct (scenario, maneuver, ablation) configurations.
